status: Hackathon demonstration SOP; requires team/QA approval before operational use

clauses.text: Keep the indicated pack on HOLD. Isolate it for QA review and preserve its inspection evidence. Appearance alone does not establish chemical contamination or root cause.

Keep the indicated pack on HOLD. Preserve the image and defect record. Reinspect against the configured pack recipe; QA reviews disposition. Do not infer drug identity or diagnose a manufacturing root cause.
Keep the pack pending REVIEW. Check camera alignment and lighting, recapture if needed, and request human review. An anomaly is an appearance deviation, not a confirmed defect type.
Record the existing rule-engine PASS and its evidence. This assistant cannot approve product release, certify drug safety, or change the inspection decision.
